prior_summary: Predict bowl-frame absolute Cartesian targets while a registered shared condition encoder is trained by masked three-class causal phase supervision in addition to action diffusion.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when closure/lift phase is ambiguous, entry is just-closed or already-lifted, or a secured source should be staged relative to the observed bowl. Finger width, source height, and two-frame co-motion cues must be reliable.
termination_guidance: Use physical closure, source/TCP co-motion, clearance, and bowl-relative stage to decide handoff; never use the phase auxiliary alone as contact evidence. The full [180,360) overlap supports successor entry after secure lift.
limitations: The auxiliary is a three-class observation proxy, not contact truth, and successful demonstrations contain no slip recovery. Bowl-frame actions do not protect ungrasped acquisition against source-only displacement; use the source-frame prior in that case.
